fetch_gate: All listed model/source/checkpoint/prediction-policy bindings and evaluator code plus a real original-validation evaluator preflight must be sealed before fetching test bytes. A placeholder or missing model cannot pass the gate.

fixed_groups.weights: original six-run alignment evidence, each actual training source dictionary retained

excluded_models_by_design: Matched-recipe architecture, augmentation repetitions and second-partition models are original-training validation confirmations. They are not selected or added to this external model set after observing results.

inference.precision: FP32, autocast off, fixed original model normalization and model.eval, no Teacher, no calibration
inference.two_view_policy: main_KD_BEST only: q64=(softmax64(z_raw)+softmax64(z_flip))/2; NLL computed separately by stable logaddexp(logp_raw,logp_flip)-log(2), avoiding underflow; both saved logit arrays remain FP32
inference.NLL: Stable float64 log-softmax recomputation from saved float32 logits; probability-mean policy uses stable logaddexp of the two log-probabilities minus log(2)
inference.historical_BF16_comparison_limit: This uniform external FP32 protocol is explicitly separate from original native BF16 batch-reduced validation CE. Do not claim their final rounding digits are identical.
inference.prediction: raw: stable FP64 softmax from saved FP32 logits then NumPy argmax (first class on an exact tie); two-view: arithmetic mean of the separately computed FP64 probabilities, then argmax; no FP32 probability mean is used
inference.historical_rounding_boundary: Forward tensors are uniformly FP32, while probabilities and scoring use FP64. Historical FP32 softmax/mean q and native BF16 batch CE are different reductions; borderline argmax and final rounding digits need not be identical. No cross-batch bitwise identity is claimed.

schema_gate_before_inference.label_names: Check semantic order against the original CIFAR10 class metadata; never infer or reorder classes from model predictions
schema_gate_before_inference.publisher_README_channel_typo: Actual RGB shape must be checked; the README nx32x32x10 line is not an accepted image schema
schema_gate_before_inference.RGB_and_label_semantics: HWC RGB uint8 and standard CIFAR10 label order are fixed by publisher dataset identity; canonical original class metadata is checked. Shape/dtype alone cannot independently establish semantic annotation correctness; never infer or relabel from predictions.

overlap_rule.canonical_hash: SHA256 of each uint8 HWC image in contiguous C byte order
overlap_rule.reference: All original60000 images, with original train45k/val5k/officialtest10k categories reported separately
overlap_rule.primary: All2000 supplied external test images, no outcome-based exclusion
overlap_rule.secondary: Exclude every exact-pixel overlap with any original60000 image, regardless of labels or model outputs
overlap_rule.external_internal_duplicates_and_label_c: Count and disclose, retain in the primary metric; do not define a new exclusion rule after viewing outcomes

fixed_paired_contrasts: alignment_B_BEST minus alignment_A_BEST: accuracy and NLL
weighted_single_LAST minus main_KD_LAST: NLL and accuracy
confidence_mass_LAST minus main_KD_LAST: NLL and accuracy
weighted_single_LAST minus confidence_mass_LAST: NLL and accuracy
main_KD_BEST two_view minus raw: accuracy and NLL
main_KD_BEST raw minus noKD240_BEST: accuracy and NLL

uncertainty.sampling: Class-stratified image resampling; share every sampled image index across methods, training seeds and prediction policies
uncertainty.aggregation: Mean of three paired per-seed metrics, not6000 independent observations
uncertainty.interval: Percentile95 conditional descriptive interval; includes image resampling only, excludes retraining/Teacher/model-selection uncertainty; no familywise significance claim
uncertainty.published_image_rows_are_the_units: Internal duplicates retained by the primary design are disclosed; conditional row bootstrap does not newly certify independent pixel identities.
uncertainty.primary_secondary_rng: Restart private PCG64(20261127) for each prespecified population; share draws across every model/seed/policy/contrast within that population.

retirement: After this one fixed analysis, retire CIFAR10.2 from all further development or model selection. A partial-run repair may only resume the identical frozen evaluator/model manifest, preserve failed artifacts, and cannot modify model or policy choices.
